Question 3(b) [4 marks]: Explain how sequencing and scheduling tools could be used in the production of the new vehicle at Small Wall Motors.
STIMULUS / CASE INFORMATION:
Small Wall Motors are about to introduce a new vehicle into their range. They aim to have the vehicle on the market within twelve months.

MARKING CRITERIA (out of 4):
3–4 marks: Defines sequencing and scheduling and explains ways that Gantt charts and/or CPA could help improve Small Wall Motors' ability to deliver the new vehicle on time
1–2 marks: Sketches in general terms sequencing and/or scheduling and may explain ways Gantt charts and/or CPA could help

SAMPLE ANSWER (official):
Sequencing and scheduling tools identify all steps in the operations process and organise them into the most efficient order. A Gantt chart records the tasks involved and estimates the time needed for each; a CPA flow diagram shows the interrelationship of tasks, and the critical path is the longest path, which gives the shortest time to complete the project. Small Wall Motors could use either to complete its operations process more efficiently and ensure on-time delivery of the new vehicle, for example organising the delivery of raw materials in the order needed for production, the assembly line in order of need, and JIT inventory control.
